name: arkandia
description: Arkandia's toolkit of AI coding-agent skills. `agent-context` bootstraps a minimal documentation pack (AGENTS.md, architecture, ADRs, data model, infrastructure) for any repository, and `agent-context-dotnet` adds a specialized .NET deep-dive (solution/project graph, target frameworks, EF Core, DI, analyzers, CI) — both validate the most important generated claims with you to reduce hallucinations. `plan-and-build` drives a small feature brief from read → explore → plan → adversarial review → your approval → test-first build → gates → commit, one phase at a time, and `plan-and-build-dotnet` adds Azure Boards work items and .NET/Make gates.
